 Netflix viewers can't stop watching show with 'most beautiful episode of TV ever'
 "I had like seven friends beg me to watch this."
 Add to preferred sources Comments TV Ketsuda Phoutinane Spare Time Content Editor 07:11, 23 Oct 2026 Updated 11:41, 23 Oct 2026 View 4 Images Carla Gugino in The Haunting of Hill House (2018) (Image: Netflix) 
 Autumn leaves are piling up, there's a chill in the air, and nights are drawing in faster with every passing day. But instead of dreading the cold months ahead, one failsafe way to beat the winter blues is to get stuck into a very good show.
 ‌ 
 ‌ 
 If bundling up with cosy throw, a good snack, and some 10/10 telly sounds tempting, might we suggest The Haunting of Hill House? For many Netflix viewers, October is the time of year they continually return to this one particular "masterpiece".
 ‌ 
 Halloween is just around the corner, and even if you can't stomach scary movies, Hill House is so widely praised it could be worth reconsidering. The show's captivating writing and strong acting have hooked many self-professed scaredy cats.
 ‌ 
 As one such viewer said on Reddit: "I absolutely hate horror but had like 7 friends beg me to watch this, claiming the emotional intelligence of the story negated any downsides of my dislike of horror.
 "I watched every episode in full daylight and even some through my fingers, but man were they right. Incredible series."
 View 4 Images Victoria Pedretti stars in Netflix's The Haunting series, made up of The Haunting of Bly Manor and The Haunting of Hill House. (Image: NETFLIX) 
 ‌ 
 What is the Haunting of Hill House about?
 The Haunting of Hill House is about five siblings who continue to be plagued by the supernatural experiences of their childhood.
 "Flashing between past and present, a fractured family confronts haunting memories of their old home and the terrifying events that drove them from it," says the show synopsis.
 ‌ 
 The story is told over two timelines; the present day and flashbacks leading up to a fateful day in 1992. In the summer of that fateful year, the Crain family move into Hill House. The plan was to fund the family's dream home by renovating and selling the mansion.
 View 4 Images The Crain family (Image: Netflix) 
 ‌ 
 However, building delays prolong their stay and terrifying events force them to flee the house. In the present day, a tragedy forces them together to confront the ghosts of their past.
 Its ensemble cast features Michiel Huisman, Elizabeth Reaser, Oliver Jackson-Cohen, Kate Siegel, and Victoria Pedretti as the grown up Crain children.
 ‌ 
 The show is loosely based on the 1969 book of the same name by Shirley Jackson. The show is a standalone 10-episode miniseries that was originally released in October 2018.
 What are viewers saying?
 The show has a superb 93% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes. The website's critics consensus says: "The Haunting of Hill House is an effective ghost story whose steadily mounting anticipation is just as satisfying as its chilling payoff."
 ‌ 
 A fan of the show brought it up on Reddit this month, writing: "I almost forgot how hauntingly beautiful 'Haunting of Hill House' is...
 "Considering it's Halloween month I was in the mood for [something] spooky. Such a beautiful show. Its haunting music, great actors. It's easily the best show Mike Flanagan has ever done. A true masterpiece. Way better than his current show Carrie, which has a YA feel to it. I hope he goes back to this kind of stuff...
 ‌ 
 "Highly recommended. Give it a try if you haven't seen it yet."
 View 4 Images The cast of The Haunting of Hill House (Image: Getty Images for Netflix) 
 ‌ 
 A chorus of viewers agreed. One said: "Episode 6 -- shot entirely in one take -- is perhaps the best and most beautiful episode of television ever produced. Just monumental on every level."
 Another replied: "True masterpiece. The actors were so well chosen. He kept them for many of his other shows as well." Others said they "love" rewatching the show, with one fan dubbing it "Absolute perfection 10/10".
 Article continues below Another said: "I first watched the Haunting of Hill House in 2018 since it was released. I watched it the second time in 2019 and now - in 2022 - the third time. It made me come back to it the third time since there hasn't been a better horror series released than this. I missed the experience watching it so I wanted to experience it again."
 Where can you stream The Haunting of Hill House?
 All 10 episodes of The Haunting of Hill House series are available to watch on Netflix at any time. The episodes range from 42–71 minutes long.
